title: EXPOZY Template Schema v1
description: JSON Schema for AI-generated EXPOZY page templates. Defines structured output constraints for LLM-based template generation, ensuring validity, security, and EXPOZY framework compatibility.

dataSources.description: Declared REST API calls (maps to EXPOZY apiData pattern)

actions.description: Declared user interaction actions (maps to EXPOZY alpineListener pattern)

Metadata.description: Template package metadata including identification, routing, and SEO

id.description: Unique template identifier (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens)

pageType.description: Page type classification for routing and behavior

schemaVersion.description: Template schema version for compatibility checking

title.description: Page title (recommended max 60 chars for display)

tailwindMode.description: Tailwind class usage mode: freeform allows any valid classes, tokenized uses design tokens, restricted limits to a predefined set

darkMode.description: Whether dark mode variants should be generated

responsive.description: Whether responsive breakpoints should be used

ColorValue.description: Color value: hex (#RRGGBB), Tailwind color (indigo-600), or CSS keyword

DataSource.description: Declarative REST API data source (maps to EXPOZY apiData attribute pattern)

id.description: Unique identifier for this data source

endpoint.description: API endpoint in EXPOZY format: method.resource (e.g., get.products, post.carts)

keyName.description: Key in global data object where response is stored (data[keyName])

autoLoad.description: Whether to load data automatically on page init

refreshOn.description: Event names that trigger a refresh of this data source

pushUrl.description: Update browser URL with request parameters

binding.description: Dynamic binding to global data (e.g., data.pageUrl.page)

ParamValue.description: Parameter value: static or dynamic binding

Action.description: User interaction action (maps to EXPOZY alpineListener pattern)

endpoint.description: Action endpoint in EXPOZY format: Module.method_name (e.g., Shop.post_carts, User.post_login)

keyName.description: Key in global data object for response storage

id.description: Optional unique identifier for the component

TailwindClasses.description: Tailwind CSS class string (space-separated utility classes)

show.description: Expression for x-show (element hidden but in DOM)

if.description: Expression for x-if (element removed from DOM)

html.description: HTML content binding (x-html) - USE WITH CAUTION, requires sanitization

actionRef.description: Reference to a declared action by ID

navigate.description: SPA navigation path using href() function

SafeExpression.description: Safe Alpine.js expression (restricted character set to prevent injection)

productBinding.description: Expression to access product data (e.g., 'product' in a loop)

postBinding.description: Expression to access post data (e.g., 'post' in a loop)

size.description: Visual size (can differ from semantic level)

external.description: If true, opens in new tab with rel=noopener

spa.description: If true, uses href() for SPA navigation

actionRef.description: Reference to a declared action for form submission

TemplateLoopProps.description: Template loop for iterating over data (maps to x-for on <template>)

dataSource.description: Reference to data source ID for pagination

triggerId.description: ID of the modal for triggering

content.description: Sanitized HTML content - MUST be validated before rendering

sanitize.description: Whether to sanitize content on render

actionRef.description: Action to trigger on filter change

itemsBinding.description: Dynamic breadcrumb items from data binding

CustomComponentProps.description: Custom component for extensibility (requires additional validation)
